title: Chapter 60 — Multi-Unit Project Quoting
intro: The quote as competitive weapon — speed, accuracy, and margin protection.

sections.title: Speed and Accuracy Win
sections.content:
In multi-unit projects, the first accurate quote often wins. Speed demonstrates capability. Accuracy demonstrates reliability. Both matter more than price.

Build quoting templates for common configurations. Know your margin thresholds. Respond same-day whenever possible.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating multi-unit quoting, ask:

Is the salesperson responding to quote requests within 24 hours?
Are quotes accurate and complete — including delivery, installation, and accessories?
Are margin thresholds being protected — or eroded under pressure?
